text:
Ava Morales: pushed rerank-release/v3-int8 to staging this morning. quick smoke shows an NDCG@10 gap for tiny queries (<=6 tokens). curious if this is a quant mapping artifact or a new preproc. anyone with bandwidth?
Jon Park: can you share the eval spec + sample size?
Ava Morales: ran against sample_cohort_v2 (~50k queries). command: `bin/eval_rerank --model rerank-release/v3-int8 --cohort sample_cohort_v2 --slices tiny,short,long --metrics ndcg10,mrr`. output attached in artifact.
Priya Nair: looked at artifact. tiny: base=0.305 -> v3=0.279 (-8.5%). short: small delta. long: v3 actually +4.0%.
Omar Haddad: that pattern smells like either (a) tokenization change for short ambiguous queries or (b) embedding magnitude shrink due to int8 scaling. Priya, any embed stats?
Priya Nair: grabbed the embedding dump. tiny L2 means: base=0.98 std=0.13, v3=0.79 std=0.21. short: base=1.01 -> v3=0.97. long: base=1.06 -> v3=1.09.
Ava Morales: interesting, tiny embeddings compressed a lot. that would reduce score spread for cosine/sim-based scorer.
Jon Park: did v3 change tokenization? I remember a patch to normalize punctuation.
Elaine Wu: yes v3 included a normalization step: strip-trailing-punct + lowercase-only-on-words > 2 chars. intended to reduce casing mismatch, but we didn't evaluate tiny-query sensitivity.
Priya Nair: ran a quick probe: apply runtime rescale (x1.25) to v3 embeddings -> tiny NDCG@10 improves to 0.292 (still -4.3% vs base).
Omar Haddad: try disabling the new punctuation normalization for a short sample.
Ava Morales: i disabled punct-strip and re-ran on 10k tiny queries: ndcg10=0.303 (within noise of base).
Jon Park: that points to preprocessing being dominant. but quant / rescale still plays a role. both additive.
ci-bot: new evaluation finished for rerank-release/v3-int8 on sample_cohort_v2 (run id: 2026-03-22-11).
Priya Nair: proposed mitigation plan: 1) revert punct-strip by default in staging, 2) add an eval-check that flags >7% ndcg drop on tiny bucket, 3) add embed L2 mean delta check >10% as warning.
Omar Haddad: also recommend adding a quick A/B policy to route <=6 token queries to fallback model while we iterate. low-risk and buys time.
Ava Morales: agree. i'll open a PR for the revert + eval-checks. will also document the probe commands in the PR description.
Jon Park: for completeness, let's add a cross-dataset sanity: run the tiny bucket on both sample_cohort_v2 and prod_holdout_small. sometimes dataset composition hides fragility.
Elaine Wu: i kicked off those two runs with the revert in a separate branch. ETA ~45m.
Priya Nair: also logging note: the embed compression pattern suggests our quant scale calibration might be slightly aggressive for short-context sequences. we should add a calibration pass that optimizes per-length quant scales next.
Ava Morales: good call. i'll file a tracker for per-seqlen quant calibration.
Omar Haddad: small UX note: add a line to the console smoke that prints per-bucket ndcg diff with tiny highlighted if >5%. saves us manual inspection.
Ava Morales: wrapping up action items: PR to revert punct-strip + eval checks (Ava), per-seqlen quant calibration ticket (Priya), A/B routing policy prototype (Omar), run cross-dataset sanity (Elaine). i'll post links here when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
